group-visit.001: Group Visit Guide | Natural Heritage Center
group-visit.002: Group visit guide, precautions, and parking information for the Natural Heritage Center.
group-visit.005: The Natural Heritage Center exhibition hall is the only exhibition hall in Korea dedicated to natural heritage.
group-visit.006: The Natural Heritage Center is a national research institute established to widely inform the public of the value and importance of natural heritage by systematically researching, exhibiting, and educating about natural monuments and scenic sites.
group-visit.007: The exhibition hall displays research results on natural heritage to help researchers and young people learn, and offers unique learning experiences through augmented reality (AR), search kiosks, and a video room.
group-visit.009: Please refer to the banners and notices on the Natural Heritage Center website.
group-visit.011: To protect our precious natural heritage and maintain order during visits, please observe the following.
group-visit.013: Please visit quietly and calmly so as not to disturb other visitors.
group-visit.014: In particular, visitors accompanied by children are asked to guide them so that they do not make noise or run around in the exhibition hall.
group-visit.015: Entry may be refused if you disturb order in the exhibition rooms, interfere with other visitors, or do not follow staff guidance and instructions.
group-visit.017: Please be careful not to touch or damage the exhibits, and guide children not to touch or climb on them.
group-visit.018: Anyone who destroys or damages an exhibit must take responsibility and pay compensation under Article 9 of the Natural Heritage Center visitor regulations. Photography with flash or tripods, smoking, bringing in food, and entry of pets are prohibited to protect the exhibits and keep a pleasant environment.
group-visit.020: For order and efficient viewing in the exhibition hall, please follow the designated visiting order.
group-visit.021: Please visit in order, starting from the Natural Monument Plants corner.
group-visit.023:
- Use the visitor parking lot on the left of the Natural Heritage Center entrance road (capacity: 20 regular, 4 disabled, 3 large vehicles)
- If the visitor lot is full, please use a nearby lot. (Nearby parking is available at Hanbat Arboretum, with 3 hours of free parking.)

info-overview.001: Overview · Overall Guide | Natural Heritage Center
info-overview.002: Purpose and significance of the founding of the Natural Heritage Center, and its history.
info-overview.004: View of the Natural Heritage Center research building
info-overview.005: The Natural Heritage Center is a national research institute established to widely inform the public of the value and importance of natural heritage through systematic research, exhibition, and education on natural monuments and scenic sites.
info-overview.006: The exhibition hall displays research results on natural heritage, such as fossils including dinosaur eggs and footprints, taxidermy specimens of Asiatic black bears, otters, and vultures, and plant specimens such as the Jondori pine, helping researchers and young people learn, and provides unique hands-on learning through experience spaces, search kiosks, and a video room.
info-overview.007: Video exhibit of the natural reserves
info-overview.009: In addition, through academic exchange with UNESCO and natural heritage institutions and natural history museums around the world, we are growing into a truly leading natural heritage research institution.

notice-article.001: Cheongsong Gowari Baekseoktan potholes designated as a Natural Monument | Natural Heritage Center
notice-article.002: The Baekseoktan potholes in Gowari, Cheongsong have been designated as a Natural Monument.
notice-article.003: The grounds for this designation are as follows.
notice-article.007: A relatively rare case formed in sedimentary bedrock, unlike ordinary potholes
notice-article.009: Structures showing past depositional environments, such as bedding and cross-bedding, can be observed
notice-article.011: Zircon age analysis confirmed a geological link with the Cretaceous Hayang Group
notice-article.013: A landform shaped together by faulting, jointing, and river erosion, with high academic value
notice-view.003: In addition, you can also see the natural monument Jeju black cattle newly exhibited at the Natural Heritage Center.
notice-view.004: We hope you will experience the diverse forms and value of our natural heritage in person.
notice-view.005: We ask for your interest in and visits to the Natural Heritage Center, now enriched with new exhibits.
